simple.meaning: מוּךְ (mûwk) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to become thin , i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Leviticus, beginning at Leviticus 25:25. Its contexts include family, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּךְ (H4134).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

structuredEvidence.definition: to become thin , i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished

firstOccurrence.englishText: “ ‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

timeline.evidenceText: “ ‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
“ ‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.
“ ‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

“ ‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

definitions.short: to become thin , i.e. (figuratively) be impoverished
definitions.full: H4134. muk [ מוּךְ ] verb be low, depressed, grow poor (Late Hebrew id. , Niph`al; Aramaic מוּךְ , sink or bend down ; compare מָכַח , Syriac , be brought low, humble ); — Qal Perfect consecutive וּמָח Lev 27:8 (P); Imperfect יָמוּח 25:25 , 35 , 39 (all H); Participle מָח 25:47 (P): all of impoverished Israelites.
